snippet.title: Co-op with Boss Fights | Guardians of the Wall – Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. 
Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3575220
